labels.agentEgressSecrets: Secrets exposed to the agent (one row per env var)
labels.agentEgressReplaceInQuery: Also replace in URL query string

tooltips.oAuthAccount: The OAuth Account linked to this credential for automatic token management. Only applicable for OAuth 2.0 credential types.
tooltips.config: JSON configuration containing the credential data. For OAuth types, fields provided by OAuth tokens are resolved automatically at runtime.
tooltips.agentEgress: When enabled, agentbox receives high-entropy placeholders instead of real secret values. The egress proxy substitutes the real value only for allowlisted hosts. Add multiple rows to expose username + password (or any multi-part secrets) as separate env vars.
tooltips.rotationReminderDays: Days before expiration to notify for rotation

messages.agentEgressHelp: Guest agents never see real secrets. Add one row per env var — e.g. API_USERNAME → username and API_PASSWORD → password. Outbound HTTP through the egress proxy swaps placeholders only for the hosts you allow.
messages.agentEgressPlaceholderModeHelp: Shared marker is easiest to recognize in logs as placeholders. Unique mode uses a fully random string per secret.
messages.agentEgressConfigPathHelp: Dot path into this credential’s configuration after OAuth merge (e.g. username, password, accessToken, keySecret). Path must resolve to a non-empty scalar on save.
messages.agentEgressHostsHelp: Comma-separated host patterns. Supports * wildcards (e.g. api.github.com, *.googleapis.com).
messages.agentEgressReplaceInQueryHelp: Off by default. Only enable if the target API requires the secret in the query string (prefer headers).
messages.agentEgressRequiresSecret: Add at least one env var when injection is enabled
messages.agentEgressInvalidEnvName: Use an uppercase env name (A–Z, 0–9, _). e.g. API_USERNAME
messages.agentEgressDuplicateEnvName: Env variable name must be unique across all secrets
messages.agentEgressInvalidConfigPath: Invalid path format. Use dot segments like username or nested.key.
messages.agentEgressInvalidOAuthConfigPath: Path must be accessToken, access_token, refreshToken, refresh_token, or data.<key>.
messages.agentEgressHostsRequired: At least one allowed host is required
